name: Hope
description:
Level 6-0 Highlighted Mix

100% Brazilian Remy human hair with a beautiful Level 6-0 base blended with a dimensional highlighted mix throughout.

The highlights add brightness and contrast while the deeper base keeps the overall color soft, rich, and natural looking.

Because this is 100% human hair, treat and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, but shipping may affect the finished look, so you may want to restyle her to your preference after unboxing.
